title: Long-range attraction in aqueous colloidal suspensions.
abstract: Long-range attractions in aqueous suspensions were observed between polymeric microspheres and also between microspheres and a gel bead. Attractive displacements were consistently seen even between like-charged entities, and they were observed over spans as large as 2 mm. Such behaviors are unexpected, and may reside in a long-range attraction mechanism.
journal: Proceedings of SPIE--the International Society for Optical Engineering
